evidence.title: Patch the Planet: a Daybreak initiative to support open source maintainers

summary: Daybreak has introduced a new program called 'Patch the Planet' aimed at providing financial and operational support to open source software maintainers. The initiative seeks to sustain critical projects by addressing funding gaps and burnout in the open source community.
title: Daybreak Launches 'Patch the Planet' Initiative to Support Open Source Maintainers
